workflow_name: HAP evidence metadata and test validation

artifact.name: hap-test-report
artifact.note: SHA-256 is the uploaded artifact ZIP digest reported by GitHub, not a separately recomputed digest of the JSON file inside.

limitations: Evidence applies to the tested commit only; later documentation-only commits were not the tested head.
This proves the fixed CI checks and nine unit tests passed; it does not prove plugin installation, target-device behavior, OS-level sandbox isolation, security review, or Phase 0 gate completion.
Only the successful-run artifact upload path was observed; upload behavior after a failing test has not been exercised.
The validator checks evidence metadata structure and does not recompute source SHA-256 values or establish authenticity.
